from pathlib import Path
import json,re

tid="DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-IMPORT-20261007-E112"
model_task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"
home=Path.home()
wt=home/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees"/tid
bundle=wt/"knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
campaign=home/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
state=home/".local/state/prediction-project-executor"

out={
 "worktree_exists":wt.exists(),
 "bundle_exists":bundle.exists(),
 "overlay_exists":(bundle/"overlay.json").exists(),
 "model_result_exists":(campaign/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json").exists(),
}
if (bundle/"overlay.json").exists():
 try:
  ov=json.loads((bundle/"overlay.json").read_text())
  out["overlay_astra_reviews"]=ov.get("astra_reviews")
  out["overlay_queue_status"]=ov.get("queue_status")
  out["overlay_has_build"]=bool(ov.get("experiment_build"))
 except Exception as e:
  out["overlay_error"]=type(e).__name__+":"+str(e)

mr=campaign/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json"
if mr.exists():
 try:
  m=json.loads(mr.read_text())
  out["model_result"]={k:m.get(k) for k in ("task_id","phase","checkpoint","completion_sha256","worker_sha256","status") if k in m}
  cp=campaign/m.get("checkpoint","")
  out["checkpoint_exists"]=cp.exists()
  if cp.exists():
   for name in ("TASK.json","WORKER.json","COMPLETE.json","events.jsonl"):
    p=cp/name
    out[f"checkpoint_{name}_exists"]=p.exists()
   wp=cp/"WORKER.json"
   if wp.exists():
    w=json.loads(wp.read_text())
    out["worker_model"]=w.get("model")
    out["worker_selection"]=w.get("model_selection")
   cpj=cp/"COMPLETE.json"
   if cpj.exists():
    c=json.loads(cpj.read_text())
    out["complete_keys"]=sorted(c.keys())
    out["complete_timestamp"]=c.get("timestamp")
 except Exception as e:
  out["model_result_error"]=type(e).__name__+":"+str(e)

# Find compact traceback/error evidence in executor state/worktree.
snips=[]
roots=[state,wt]
for root in roots:
 if not root.exists(): continue
 for p in root.rglob("*"):
  try:
   if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size>2_000_000: continue
  except OSError:
   continue
  if p.suffix.lower() not in {".json",".jsonl",".log",".txt",""}: continue
  try:
   txt=p.read_text(errors="replace")
  except Exception:
   continue
  if tid not in txt and "Traceback" not in txt and "MODEL_" not in txt and "POSTBUILD" not in txt:
   continue
  lines=txt.splitlines()
  score=0
  for s in ("Traceback","Error","Exception","MODEL_","POSTBUILD","rc=1",tid):
   if s in txt: score+=1
  if score==0: continue
  match=[]
  for i,line in enumerate(lines):
   if any(s in line for s in ("Traceback","Error","Exception","MODEL_","POSTBUILD","rc=1",tid)):
    lo=max(0,i-2); hi=min(len(lines),i+8)
    match=lines[lo:hi]
    break
  snips.append((score,str(p),"\n".join(match)[:1800]))
snips.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
out["evidence_snippets"]=[{"path":p,"text":s} for _,p,s in snips[:8]]
print("E113_DIAG "+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":"),default=str),flush=True)
